_comment_source: Example values. Point this at the skill root you install from; adjust every path to your own environment.
_comment_optional_targets: Opt-in only. sync-skills.ps1 never touches these roots unless you pass -IncludeAgentsRoot, and a missing root is deliberately reported as a failure instead of being created. Delete this list (or leave it empty) if you do not use an agents skill root.
_comment_manifest: skills lists every skill this manifest owns; sync-skills.ps1 mirrors strictly inside each listed skill directory and never creates, deletes or modifies anything else in the target roots. Rename this file to manifest.json or pass it with -ManifestPath.
